projects.title: SuperSort
projects.goal: Search for genuinely new, architecture-aware mechanisms that make practically relevant sorting tasks substantially faster than the best existing implementations.

latest.title: Sorting repeated keys together across exception gaps
latest.summary: A mask grouped nearby equal keys despite interruptions, but the fixed blocks produced more tags than exact runs on the four main inputs. The full sort reached 1.004-1.086× against the run-based reference.
